promptBase: Edit this furniture atlas into a new coordinated designer colorway. EXACTLY 15 separate objects in a strict evenly spaced 5 columns x 3 rows grid, preserve all original objects in their exact cell order, same silhouettes, perspective and scale within each cell. One object per cell, generous transparent gutters. Transparent background, no labels or borders. Preserve intricate hand-painted Korean fantasy storybook RPG art, no global tint or hue filter. Redesign material-specific colors:
constraints: Preserve every furniture identity, perspective and cell order. No global hue tint. Transparent gutters, no backdrop or shadows. The mint first sheet was passed through image_gen background extraction preserving all fifteen props.
packing: Each generated 5x3 sheet is cut into individual cells and fitted proportionally to the original alpha bounds on 320x320 canvases. Pixel colors are generated by image_gen, not hue rotation.
